04/ 13.09.2024 Petitioner has been made accused in connection with Jamtara Cyber Crime P.S. Case No. 32 of 2024 for the offences registered under Sections 413/414/419/420/467/468/471 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 66 (B) (C) (D) of the I.T. sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that it is alleged that three smart mobile phone along with SIM cards have been got recovered from petitioner.

It has further been pointed out that petitioner is in judicial custody since 17.05.2024 and chargesheet has already been submitted and there is no possibility of fleeing away of petitioner, as also tampering with evidence, if admitted to bail.
Upon aforesaid premise, prayer for bail has been made.
3. Learned PP appearing for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.
Counter affidavit has been placed on record by learned PP appearing for the State.

Learned PP for the State by pointing out paragraph 39 and 40 of the case diary tried to convince this Court that in the present case during course of investigation, I.O has recorded the statement of victim, from whose account certain amount has been fleeced away by the petitioner.
Upon aforesaid premise, he objected the prayer for bail.
From perusal of record it transpires that there is allegation against the petitioner that he used to fleeced away money from different persons by using the recovered mobile phone and SIMs.
Submission has been made that the chargesheet has already been submitted.
The case record reveals that petitioner is having three cases of similar nature to his credit.

sentences.text: But, considering the totality of the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, as the chargesheet has already been submitted, therefore petitioner is not required for further investigation, this Court do find it a fit case for grant of bail to the petitioner.

The petitioner named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees twenty five thousand), with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge-I, Jamtara, in connection with Jamtara Cyber Crime P.S.
